summary: Documentation only: the operator accepts ADR-0050 (independent security evidence and narrow dependency bumps), merged as proposed. Status proposed -> accepted, date 2026-11-08, decision-maker operator, and one closing paragraph recording the rollout fixtures (passing status from the dedicated App on a valid fixture, failing status on a fixture that removed its PR-side gate and record). The ADR index row and the CHANGELOG line follow. No workflow, checker, skill, threat model, register, configuration or code change; TM-16 is referenced because ADR-0050 governs the review mechanism itself.
limitations: Rollout step 4 of design/continuous-security-review.md (requiring skirnir/trusted-security-review with the dedicated App as expected source in branch protection) is a repository setting outside this PR and not yet verified as enforced.
